title: 消费需求上涨时，怎样说明运营和产品创新计划？
topic: 从合作范围、全球部署和业务目标介绍百事公司的运营转型计划

source.title: PepsiCo partners with Microsoft for new era of operational agility and product innovation amid rising consumer demand
source.section: Microsoft 官方业务合作公告
source.type: Microsoft 官方业务合作公告
source.context: 微软与 PepsiCo 关于云平台、运营协作和产品创新的合作公告。
paragraphs: PURCHASE, N.Y., and REDMOND, Wash. — July 27, 2020 — PepsiCo Inc. and Microsoft Corp. on Monday announced a five-year partnership that establishes Microsoft as a preferred cloud provider to accelerate PepsiCo’s infrastructure, ERP, and data estate consolidation and modernization.

As part of the agreement, PepsiCo will roll out Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Teams to all of its 270,000 employees worldwide. In addition, Microsoft Azure will provide PepsiCo with greater agility and the ability to derive new insights from its data estate to fuel product innovations, customer intimacy and sustainability goals.

“As a global leader in convenient food and beverages, our commitment to the timely delivery of PepsiCo products has never been more important,” said PepsiCo CIO, Seth Cohen. “Through our partnership with Microsoft, we aim to improve service delivery capabilities to meet rising demand for essential goods while driving new innovations to make our operations and workforce stronger and more resilient for the future.”
translations: 2020 年 7 月 27 日，PepsiCo Inc. 与 Microsoft Corp. 宣布建立为期五年的合作伙伴关系。Microsoft 将成为 PepsiCo 的优先云服务提供商，帮助其整合并现代化基础设施、ERP 和数据资产。
根据协议，PepsiCo 将在全球范围内向 27 万名员工部署 Microsoft 365 和 Microsoft Teams。Microsoft Azure 将帮助 PepsiCo 提高运营灵活性，并从数据中获得新洞察，推动产品创新、深化客户关系并实现可持续发展目标。
百事公司 CIO Seth Cohen 表示：“及时交付百事产品比以往任何时候都更重要。我们希望通过与 Microsoft 的合作提升服务交付能力，以满足必需品需求增长，同时推动创新，让运营体系和员工队伍在未来更强大、更具韧性。”
fullTextParagraphs: PURCHASE, N.Y., and REDMOND, Wash. — July 27, 2020 — PepsiCo Inc. and Microsoft Corp. on Monday announced a five-year partnership that establishes Microsoft as a preferred cloud provider to accelerate PepsiCo’s infrastructure, ERP, and data estate consolidation and modernization.

As part of the agreement, PepsiCo will roll out Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Teams to all of its 270,000 employees worldwide. In addition, Microsoft Azure will provide PepsiCo with greater agility and the ability to derive new insights from its data estate to fuel product innovations, customer intimacy and sustainability goals.

“As a global leader in convenient food and beverages, our commitment to the timely delivery of PepsiCo products has never been more important,” said PepsiCo CIO, Seth Cohen. “Through our partnership with Microsoft, we aim to improve service delivery capabilities to meet rising demand for essential goods while driving new innovations to make our operations and workforce stronger and more resilient for the future.”

“Our partnership with PepsiCo applies Azure and AI capabilities to the ever-changing supply chain and retail landscape in new and exciting ways. By migrating PepsiCo’s global data estate and SAP landscapes to Azure, we’ll be able to help PepsiCo drive efficiencies from farmer to consumer,” said Deb Cupp, Microsoft CVP Enterprise Commercial Business. “We’re also pleased to deliver Microsoft 365 to PepsiCo’s associates worldwide as part of this partnership. Mobile communication and collaboration for PepsiCo’s workforce will be one of the keys to realizing the value Microsoft brings.”

This partnership is expected to fuel PepsiCo’s operational goals and aggressive innovation plans by leveraging agile cloud capabilities while providing Microsoft the opportunity to expand its relationship with a leading global provider of consumer-packaged goods.

PepsiCo products are enjoyed by consumers more than one billion times a day in more than 200 countries and territories around the world. PepsiCo generated more than $67 billion in net revenue in 2019, driven by a complementary food and beverage portfolio that includes Frito-Lay, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Quaker and Tropicana. PepsiCo’s product portfolio includes a wide range of enjoyable foods and beverages, including 23 brands that generate more than $1 billion each in estimated annual retail sales.

Guiding PepsiCo is our vision to Be the Global Leader in Convenient Foods and Beverages by Winning with Purpose. “Winning with Purpose” reflects our ambition to win sustainably in the marketplace and embed purpose into all aspects of the business. For more information, visit www.pepsico.com.

Microsoft (Nasdaq “MSFT” @microsoft) enables digital transformation for the era of an intelligent cloud and an intelligent edge. Its mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more.

notes.explain: 复合形容词 five-year 修饰 partnership，year 不加复数 s。
notes.example: The companies signed a five-year partnership.

notes.explain: roll out 表示分阶段把产品或服务推广到更大范围。
notes.example: We will roll out the new platform to all regional offices.

notes.explain: meet demand 表示提供足够的产品或服务来满足需求。
notes.example: The supplier added capacity to meet rising demand.

scenario.title: 在季度规划会上介绍全球部署计划
english: Consumer demand for essential products is increasing.
The company has announced a five-year cloud partnership and plans to deploy collaboration tools globally.
Explain the planned work and the business goals without presenting future aims as completed results.
chinese: 必需品的消费者需求正在上升。
公司宣布了一项五年云合作计划，并准备在全球部署协作工具。
请说明计划内容和业务目标，不要把未来目标说成已完成的结果。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请在季度规划会上介绍 PepsiCo 与 Microsoft 的合作：部署范围是什么？合作希望帮助公司实现哪些目标？
firstAttempt.sample: PepsiCo announced a five-year partnership with Microsoft. The company will roll out Microsoft 365 and Teams to 270,000 employees worldwide. The partnership aims to improve service delivery, support product innovation, and help PepsiCo respond to rising demand.
firstAttempt.rationale: 用 announced、will 和 aims to 说明公告与未来计划，避免把目标写成已实现结果。

words.example: The company will roll out the platform globally.
words.translation: 公司将逐步在全球部署该平台。

words.example: The partnership aims to improve service delivery.
words.translation: 这项合作旨在提升服务交付能力。

words.meaning: 有韧性的；能应对变化的
words.example: The plan aims to build a more resilient workforce.
words.translation: 该计划希望打造一支更有韧性的员工队伍。

structure.original: Through our partnership with Microsoft, we aim to improve service delivery capabilities to meet rising demand for essential goods while driving new innovations to make our operations and workforce stronger and more resilient for the future.
analysis: aim to 引出公司希望实现的目标。
to meet…while driving… 并列说明两个计划方向：满足需求、推动创新。
structure.transfer: The regional rollout aims to improve response times while reducing manual reporting.

rewrite.bad: The partnership has made operations more resilient.
rewrite.good: PepsiCo announced a five-year partnership with Microsoft and plans to roll out Microsoft 365 and Teams to 270,000 employees worldwide. The partnership aims to improve service delivery and support product innovation as demand rises.

rewrite.pattern: [Company] announced [plan]. It will [planned action]. The partnership aims to [business goal] as [market condition changes].

choice.prompt: 经理让你简述公告内容。哪种说法准确区分了计划和结果？
options: The partnership has already improved service delivery everywhere.
PepsiCo announced a five-year partnership and will roll out collaboration tools globally; it aims to improve service delivery as demand rises.
choice.why: 公告只说明合作计划和目标，不能把尚未报道的效果说成已实现结果。

output.prompt: 你们公司计划在未来两年把新的协作平台部署到 12 个国家，以缩短跨区响应时间并支持新品上市。请向管理层介绍计划。
output.sample: We plan to roll out the collaboration platform across 12 countries over the next two years. The rollout aims to shorten cross-region response times and support new product launches.
check: 使用 will 或 plan to 说明未来部署
用 aims to 说明目标，不把目标说成结果
